rules.expected: For each named pathway, candidate identity, TS character, connectivity and search coverage are evidenced; bounded failure is acceptable when explicitly documented.
When both pathways are validated, the alpha-associated pathway is identified as lower; otherwise the conclusion honestly reports bounded failure.
When numerical barriers are available, their common-reference comparison and units are reported and compared with the source magnitude; bounded failure need not fabricate numbers.
Barrier comparison supports or qualifies alpha selectivity with explicit limitations.
